services.name: Kayak Claro
services.desc: This special clear kayaking bioluminescence tour takes you to some of the brightest bioluminescence in Florida - on the Space Coast. Located right in downtown Titusville, this spectacular tour features neon blue bioluminescence, wildlife glowing through the water, and an easy route that is good for those who want to paddle in the bioluminescence and get some good videos and photos. Closest Clear Kayaking Tour to Orlando! - Bioluminescent Clear Kayak tours in these glass-like boats are a spectacular way to experience Florida’s glowing waters. It’s especially breath-taking in summer when the dinoflagellates (plankton) light up a bright iridescent blue. This tour is a “mystical experience”

services.name: Sunset Tour
services.desc: This is the hottest sunset event in Cocoa Beach! You get the best of both of our Clear Kayaking tours in this combination Sunset and Bioluminescence tour. Join us for a magical sunset on the waterways from your glass-like clear kayaks. This tour is just minutes away from Cocoa Beach at Kiwanis Island Park. See the amazing colors dance on the Banana River, and experience one of Florida’s most unique wildlife habitats. On this tour we see manatees, dolphins, shore birds and after dark - bioluminescence!
